text: I recommend replacing the existing stage rigging with "rigging every touring house expects" as per your requirements for reliability, consistency, and performance across all productions. This solution ensures that the rigging meets industry standards while maintaining high safety and durability, aligning well with the expectations of touring houses. The new rigging will be installed during the "dark week" when there are fewer operations, minimizing downtime and costs associated with production interruptions. This decision prioritizes long-term operational efficiency and reliability over short-term considerations such as cost or novel approaches.
